{{Quote|To be blunt, he was always unbalanced. The alterations only pushed him over the line.|General Garza|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Revai''', callsign '''Tap''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]] and a member of [[Eclipse Squad]], a [[Republic Special Forces Division]] squad created during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> The unit's [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], Revai was identified as being "deliberate and distant" by [[Psych Division]], with a tendency to fixate on "dark thoughts."<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Eclipse Squad}}</ref> He, like the rest of Eclipse Squad, was implanted with experimental [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] recovered from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]], allowing him to neurally link with his weapons. However, the implants drove the unit insane, and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mak'eef]]&mdash;believing that the other [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] had [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] his food&mdash;started a fight at [[Fort Klemark]] on [[Altair 9]] that resulted in Eclipse Squad massacring the entire Republic garrison. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] tracked the rogue unit to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], where she recruited Eclipse Squad's predecessors [[Havoc Squad]] to draw out and [[Death/Legends|kill]] all members of Eclipse Squad.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Revai appears as an enemy in "Eclipse Squad," a class mission for the Trooper in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
